_what_this_means: The ONLY place money limits live. ONE shared pool: every % is of TOTAL account equity (live from the broker). Nothing is reserved per segment; segments share one risk budget, each with a maximum share. Raise equity and every rupee limit and every lot/qty size grows with it. Non-money settings (stop-loss %, R:R, Greeks budget, liquidity, time windows, strategy rules) stay in their existing config files -- this file is rupees and counts only.

account._shared_risk_rule: Sum of every open position's stop loss (equity) or defined max loss (options), across ALL segments. Any segment may use it, first come first served, up to its own max_share_of_shared_risk. Segment ceilings below sum to more than this on purpose, so segments compete for the shared room instead of each getting a locked-away slice.

options._what_this_means: Index options strategies (spreads, condors, butterflies) run inside the seller desk. One STRATEGY = one registry entry (options_seller_desk_v3, nifty_weekly_condor_simple, options_expiry_day) = one structure, all legs and all lots -- never counted by legs.
options._max_structure_loss_per_strategy_rule: The structure's defined max loss (wing minus credit) x lots must fit under this. Lots = floor(this rupee amount / max-loss-per-lot), so lot count grows automatically with equity. If 0 lots fit, the trade is refused with 'capital too small for this structure' -- never silently resized.
options._max_loss_per_day_per_strategy_rule: When ONE strategy's realized + open loss TODAY reaches this, close THAT strategy's open position(s) only, latch it off until the next trading day (survives a restart), and alert. Other strategies are untouched.
options._max_loss_per_day_all_options_strategies: Backstop across every options strategy combined. When reached: no NEW options entries today. Nothing is force-closed; each open position still keeps its own stop.
options._max_share_of_shared_risk_rule: Sum of the defined max loss of every open options structure, plus the candidate trade, must fit under this AND under account.max_loss_if_everything_open_hits_stop. Raised 1.5% -> 3% 2026-10-07: 3 desk structures (<=0.75% each = 2.25%) + the weekly condor + the expiry-day butterfly realistically need up to ~3% together -- the old 1.5% ceiling was tighter than just the desk's own max_open_strategies capacity, so new entries (the condor) were starved by the desk's own existing positions before this.

swing._what_this_means: Delivery (CNC) equity held overnight. Each trade lives by its own stop-loss and target -- no daily loss limit, by explicit decision.
swing._max_loss_per_trade_rule: Quantity = floor(this rupee amount / (entry price minus stop price)). The stop distance IS the risk.
swing._max_share_of_shared_risk_rule: Sum of (entry minus stop) x qty across every open swing trade, plus the candidate, must fit under this AND under account.max_loss_if_everything_open_hits_stop.

intraday._what_this_means: MIS equity, closed the same trading day.
intraday._max_loss_per_trade_rule: Quantity = floor(this rupee amount / (entry price minus stop price)).
intraday._max_loss_per_day_rule: Realized + open MTM loss today, checked per mode (paper and live separately). When reached: close every open intraday position and stop new intraday entries until the next trading day.
